items.raw_excerpt: Muslim liaison organisation CMO has set up a national hotline to report attacks on Dutch mosques amid concern that many incidents are going unreported. Police have admitted that discrimination is underreported in the Netherlands, while community leaders hope the hotline will encourage victims to come forward. items.summary_en: A Dutch Muslim group has launched a national hotline for reporting attacks on mosques. Police say many such incidents in the Netherlands are not reported. The online portal opens on September 20 and aims to help more people come forward.

items.raw_excerpt: Ao todo, serão acompanhados 250 pacientes do SUS atendidos pelo hospital com obesidade grave ou associada a outras morbidades”, informou o ministério.
items.summary_en: Brazil's public health system will give weight-loss pens to 250 patients. The patients have severe obesity or obesity tied to other health conditions. The federal health ministry announced the program.
items.summary_ko: 브라질 공공의료 시스템 SUS가 비만 환자 250명에게 체중 감량 주사를 제공한다. 중증 비만이거나 다른 질병을 동반한 비만 환자가 대상이다. 연방보건부가 이번 사업을 발표했다.
items.title_en: Brazil SUS to Offer Weight-Loss Pens to Obesity Patients

items.raw_excerpt: Mexico City is no stranger to earthquakes, but these neighborhoods tend to get hit the worst, writes MND contributor Andrea Fischer.
items.summary_en: Mexico City often has earthquakes. Some neighborhoods are hit the worst. Contributor Andrea Fischer looks at which areas carry the highest risk.

items.title_en: Which Mexico City neighborhoods face the highest earthquake risk?
